title: ATTENTION

intro.headline: Guess the attention pattern
intro.body: Pick a query word, guess how much it attends to every other word, then compare against the real softmax. Each word carries a feature vector; the query vector says what that word is looking for.

insight: You scored {score}/100. "{query}" puts most of its weight on {top} ({topP}). Attention is not about nearby words — it is a content lookup: the query vector asks for a kind of information, every key advertises what it has, and the softmax decides how much of each value gets mixed into the output. The bottom row is that mix.
